cells.gaps: The KSh 18.3 billion processed through e-GP is the Treasury's own figure, given in November 2026; no share of all government purchasing has been found.
cells.note: All government procurement goes through e-GP from 1 July 2026 (KEN-002), and the Treasury said in November 2026 that contracts worth about KSh 18.3 billion had been processed through it (KEN-013).
